issues: fire-drill-notify (Email board) checkbox appears to be checked by default. Since sending real emails from a test/drill is potentially undesirable, consider defaulting to unchecked. (Testing agent explicitly unchecked before run per instruction.)

critical_code_review_comments: adapter-webhook-url is an <input readonly> so its content is exposed via .value, not text_content. Not a bug, but ensure any automated screenshotting/telemetry doesn't accidentally leak the signed webhook URL to logs.
Consider defaulting fire-drill-notify to unchecked to avoid accidental email sends during operator experimentation.
